summary: Baileys fork pulls libsignal from an unpinned GitHub repo at install time
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, the dependency resolves to whatever is at the HEAD of that GitHub repository at the moment of install and runs any lifecycle scripts it ships. The referenced repository is a personal, non-vendor fork unrelated to the upstream Baileys project, and the controller of that repository can change its contents at any time without any change to this package. The resulting installer-side code execution is sourced from a mutable, third-party-controlled location rather than the npm registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
